mapper.sql: id, dict_name, dict_type, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sys_dict_type WHERE deleted = 0
AND dict_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dictName}, '%')
AND dict_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dictType}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
SELECT id, dict_name, dict_type, status FROM sys_dict_type WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_dict_type WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_dict_type WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_type (dict_name, dict_type, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version) VALUES (#{dictName}, #{dictType}, COALESCE(#{status}, 1), #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, COALESCE(#{deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{version}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_type SET deleted = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
